What his mom prayed when she thought he was asleep. 🌙

Sam was seven. Every single night, she tucked the blanket under his chin and whispered a prayer: "Jesus…" 🙏

At fifteen, Sam got better at pretending. Phone under the blanket. The door creaked, and he didn't talk. She prayed anyway: "The Lord bless you and keep you…"

68% of teens take their devices to bed (Common Sense Media, 2019). There were nights she didn't know if he was even listening. 💔

At eighteen, he moved out. On the last night, she whispered, "I'm so proud of you…" And from under the blanket, Sam finished it: "…the Lord make His face shine upon you. Mom." 🥹

6,570 nights of prayer. ✨

"He always lives to make intercession for them." Hebrews 7:25. Jesus, who gave His life, never stops praying for us. 🙏 And what your child hears at night is what keeps them through the storms. ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
